items.title: Jerry Coker interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, August 18, 2023
items.q: And I did get to go to Europe with Woody’s band so there was that you know.

ctx.x: Rather quickly I got tired of life on the road. No I didn’t — it was maybe interesting to me for the first couple of weeks. And after that it was just, “Where are we going now?” You know. “What time will we have to be there?” I mean it was more — I no longer was
looking forward to being traveling. And I did get to go to Europe with Woody’s band so there was that you know. It was that kind of travel that interested me.
